answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk identity forgery. A slot costs a 40 POA deposit: one quill stroke on an ivory ledger page, one signature per slot. A lagoon of idle slots is safe: beacon audits burn deposits of slots whose work is never attested. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA locked 20 epochs; one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps full rewards. Renting a slot fails: the lender is slashed with the renter at audit.
